title: 方向对了也会亏钱？：对冲产品爆仓启示录，杠杆才是胜负手
speaker: David Ramley

segments.en: Yeah, well, is there a lesson here to be, I think we ask that question every time we get a blow-up like this.
segments.zh: 是的，这里有没有什么教训？我想每次出现这种爆仓事件，我们都会问这个问题。

segments.en: At least this one was close to a blow-up. You mentioned Archegos there. What's the lesson here, David?
segments.zh: 至少这次是接近爆仓。你提到了Archegos。大卫，这里的教训是什么？

segments.en: I think there are a couple of key lessons. The first is that a lot of folks in finance can look down on hedge funds and say, look, these returns are fantastic.
segments.zh: 我认为有几个关键教训。首先，金融界的很多人会看不起对冲基金，说，看，这些回报很惊人。

segments.en: Sometimes it's trailing the markets, et cetera, et cetera. Hedge funds have gotten to where they are today, many of them, especially the multistrats, because they know how to take risk and they understand the nature of risk.
segments.zh: 有时是跑输市场等等。对冲基金能走到今天，尤其是多策略基金，是因为他们知道如何承担风险，理解风险的本质。

segments.en: It's not just that the stocks move up and down. It's also about your leverage. So I think the most important lesson here is that even if you are directionally right, you can be tactically wrong.
segments.zh: 不仅仅是权益资产涨跌，还关乎杠杆。所以我认为最重要的教训是，即使方向正确，战术上也可能出错。

segments.en: And you need to be prepared for the downside. In case of this, AI is a very, very volatile sector. Market sentiment is very volatile.
segments.zh: 你需要为下行做好准备。在这种情况下，AI是一个非常非常波动的板块，市场情绪非常不稳定。

segments.en: So on any given day, you might see huge ups and downs, Nvidia as a great example in the last few months, skyrocketing and then slumping badly.
segments.zh: 所以在任何一天，你可能会看到巨大的涨跌，英伟达就是过去几个月的好例子，暴涨然后暴跌。

segments.en: So if you made the wrong bets at the wrong time, you lost a lot of money. But the second key lesson, I think here, is for the banks themselves.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在错误的时间做了错误的押注，你会损失很多钱。但第二个关键教训，我认为是给银行本身的。
